snippet": "I understand the trade you\u2019re pointing at, and you\u2019re right to force it into the open:\n\nRisk A: \u201cWebRun pulls in adversarial text (prompt injection / tool coercion) and it contaminates the session.\u201d\n\nRisk B: \u201cNot using WebRun means we miss key external best practices and we bake avoidable design flaws into the OS\u2014permanently.\u201d\n\nMy judgment\nFor MetaBlooms OS work, Risk B is larger than Risk A if we do WebRun with proper containment.\nThe right answer is not \u201cnever browse\u201d and not \u201cbrowse freely.\u201d "
